defective_pattern: Applying bold formatting to table captions, retaining untranslated English acronyms in Persian tables, wrapping table notes in Markdown italics, and injecting explicit right-alignment tags inside bidirectional OpenXML containers.
why_defective: Violates strict APA 7th Edition rules (non-bold titles), Directive 4.1 (no English leakage), table note literal string parsing requirements, and Word's RTL bidirectional layout engine behavior.
observed_symptoms: Bold table captions (e.g., B Titr Bold)
Presence of Latin letters (Tol, VIF, DW, IUS) in Persian table cells
Table notes beginning with '*یادداشت.' instead of 'یادداشت:'
Text aligning to the left edge in RTL tables due to explicit <w:jc w:val='right'/>
corrective_remedy: 1. Force table captions to regular (non-bold) B Nazanin font. 2. Translate/transliterate all English acronyms (e.g., VIF -> عامل تورم واریانس). 3. Use exact string 'یادداشت:'. 4. Exclude <w:jc w:val='right'/> under <w:bidi/> or use <w:jc w:val='both'/>.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Deterministic regex pattern matching formatting defects
